scripts.build:simulator: npm run sync && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/simulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:device: npm run sync && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build/device -allowProvisioningUpdates build
